title: Station — heard
description: What a ground station actually decoded, one mark per frame per satellite, over the selected range (#403). Passes on the next-passes board are the opportunity; this is the result.

panels.title: Heard — frames $station actually decoded

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts AS time, 1 AS value, s.name AS metric FROM reception r JOIN satellite s USING (norad) WHERE r.observer = '$station' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts) UNION ALL SELECT r.ts + interval '2 minutes' AS time, NULL AS value, s.name AS metric FROM reception r JOIN satellite s USING (norad) WHERE r.observer = '$station' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Passes above are the opportunity; this is the result. One mark per decoded frame, per satellite, over the selected range (#403).
